function updHud(){ssM15SyncScene();updateMobilityHud();ssM1SyncHUD();let depth=Math.max(0,Math.floor(p.y-terrain(p.x)));const place=placeInfo(depth,biomeAt(p.x));$('placeBadge').innerHTML=`<span class="icontext tight">${asset(ssRegion==='life_forest_01'?'forest':place.icon,'sm')}<span>Lv.${deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp).level} · ${ssRegion==='life_forest_01'?'잔빛숲':ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID?'도래마을':place.label}</span></span>`;let t=TOOL_INFO[game.tool]||TOOL_INFO.pickaxe;$('toolStatus').innerHTML=`${asset(t.icon,'sm')} ${t.name} Lv.${game.pickaxeLevel}${game.tool==='pickaxe'&&game.pickaxeForge.rank?' · +'+game.pickaxeForge.rank:''}`;$('coords').textContent=ssRegion==='life_forest_01'?`잔빛숲 X ${Math.floor(p.x)}`:`X ${Math.floor(p.x)} · 깊이 ${depth}m`;ssCargoHud();$('coins').textContent=game.coins;$('mined').textContent=game.mined;$('debug').textContent=`x=${p.x.toFixed(2)} y=${p.y.toFixed(2)} inv=${game.inv.dirt} edits=${Object.keys(game.edits).length} save=${saveOkay?'ok':'blocked'}`}
// SANDSTAR UI P0 · inventory and profile are live views of the existing save data.
let ssInventoryCategory='all',ssBagCategory='all',ssInventoryOrder='default',ssInventorySelection='',ssBagSelection='';
const SS_ITEM_GROUPS=Object.freeze({orecoal:'ore',copper:'ore',iron:'ore',titanium:'ore',crystal:'gem',starshard:'gem',amber:'gem',opal:'gem'});
const SS_ITEM_GLYPHS=Object.freeze({dirt:'🟫',stone:'🪨',wood:'🪵',wall:'🧱',glass:'▣',torch:'✦',bed:'▰',chest:'▣',orecoal:'◈',copper:'◆',iron:'⬢',crystal:'✧',titanium:'◆',starshard:'✦',amber:'◇',opal:'◉'});
function ssInventoryEntries(){
 const items=[];
 for(const id of (game.unlockedTools||['pickaxe'])){
  const info=TOOL_INFO[id];if(!info||items.some(x=>x.key==='tool:'+id))continue;
  items.push({key:'tool:'+id,id,category:'tool',name:info.name,count:1,icon:asset(info.icon,'md'),details:game.tool===id?'현재 사용 중':info.tag});
 }
 for(const id of Object.keys(MATERIAL_NAMES)){
  if(id==='relic')continue;const qty=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(game.inv?.[id])||0));
  if(!qty)continue;
  items.push({key:'item:'+id,id,category:SS_ITEM_GROUPS[id]||'material',name:MATERIAL_NAMES[id],count:qty,icon:`<span class="ss-item-symbol" aria-hidden="true">${SS_ITEM_GLYPHS[id]||'◈'}</span>`,details:`보유 ${qty}개`});
 }
 for(const id of game.artifactSystem?.ownedIds||[]){
  const info=ARTIFACT_INFO[id];if(!info)continue;
  items.push({key:'artifact:'+id,id,category:'artifact',name:info.name,count:1,icon:`<span class="ss-item-symbol" aria-hidden="true">${info.icon}</span>`,details:info.tag});
 }
 return items;
}
function ssInventoryViewModel(kind='inventory'){
 const group=kind==='bag'?'bag':'inventory';
 const category=group==='bag'?ssBagCategory:ssInventoryCategory;
 let list=ssInventoryEntries().filter(item=>{
  const belongs=group==='bag'?item.category==='tool'||item.category==='artifact':item.category==='ore'||item.category==='gem'||item.category==='material';
  return belongs&&(category==='all'||item.category===category);
 });
 if(ssInventoryOrder==='name')list.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'ko'));
 else if(ssInventoryOrder==='count')list.sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'ko'));
 return list;
}
function ssOpenItems(kind='inventory'){
 const isBag=kind==='bag',title=isBag?'가방':'인벤토리';
 const previousScroll=$('overlay').classList.contains('open')&&menuType===title ? $('dialog').scrollTop : 0;
 const items=ssInventoryViewModel(kind),selection=isBag?ssBagSelection:ssInventorySelection;
 const selectedKey=items.some(x=>x.key===selection)?selection:(items[0]?.key||'');
 if(isBag)ssBagSelection=selectedKey;else ssInventorySelection=selectedKey;
 const selected=items.find(x=>x.key===selectedKey);
 const tabs=isBag?[['all','전체'],['tool','도구'],['artifact','유물']]:[['all','전체'],['ore','광물'],['gem','보석'],['material','재료']];
 const active=isBag?ssBagCategory:ssInventoryCategory;
 const categories=tabs.map(([id,label])=>`<button type="button" role="tab" data-ss-item-tab="${id}" class="${active===id?'active':''}" aria-selected="${active===id}">${label}</button>`).join('');
 const slots=items.map(item=>`<button type="button" class="ss-inv-item ${item.key===selectedKey?'selected':''}" data-ss-item-key="${item.key}" aria-label="${item.name}${item.count>1?' '+item.count+'개':''}" aria-pressed="${item.key===selectedKey}"><span class="ss-item-art">${item.icon}</span><span class="ss-item-qty">${item.count>1?item.count:''}</span></button>`).join('');
 const empty=items.length?'':'<p class="ss-inv-empty">보유한 아이템이 없어요.</p>';
 const extra=Array.from({length:Math.max(0,Math.min(6,15-items.length))},()=>'<span class="ss-inv-empty-slot" aria-hidden="true"></span>').join('');
 const labels={tool:'도구',artifact:'유물',ore:'광물',gem:'보석',material:'재료'};
 const detail=selected?`<div class="ss-item-detail"><span class="ss-detail-art">${selected.icon}</span><div><strong>${selected.name}</strong><small>${labels[selected.category]}</small><p>${selected.details}</p></div></div>`:'<div class="ss-item-detail empty">아이템을 선택해 주세요.</div>';
 const actions=isBag?`<div class="ss-ui-actions"><button id="ssBagEquip" type="button" ${!selected?'disabled':''}>${selected?.category==='tool'?(game.tool===selected.id?'사용 중':'도구 장착'):'유물 장착 관리'}</button><span class="ss-inv-counter">${items.length}종</span></div>`:`<div class="ss-ui-actions"><button id="ssInvSort" type="button">정렬: ${ssInventoryOrder==='default'?'기본':ssInventoryOrder==='name'?'이름':'수량'}</button><span class="ss-inv-counter">${items.length}종</span></div>`;
 showModal(title,`<nav class="ss-inv-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="${title} 분류">${categories}</nav><div class="ss-inv-grid" role="group" aria-label="보유 아이템">${slots}${extra}${empty}</div>${detail}${actions}`);
 $('dialog').classList.add('ss-ui-modal',isBag?'ss-bag-modal':'ss-inventory-modal');$('backBtn').textContent='닫기';
 $('dialog').classList.remove('ss-profile-modal','ss-settings-modal',isBag?'ss-inventory-modal':'ss-bag-modal');
 $('dialog').scrollTop=previousScroll;
 for(const tab of $('dialog').querySelectorAll('[data-ss-item-tab]'))tab.onclick=()=>{if(isBag){ssBagCategory=tab.dataset.ssItemTab;ssBagSelection='';}else{ssInventoryCategory=tab.dataset.ssItemTab;ssInventorySelection='';}ssOpenItems(kind);$('dialog').scrollTop=0;};
 for(const button of $('dialog').querySelectorAll('[data-ss-item-key]'))button.onclick=()=>{if(isBag)ssBagSelection=button.dataset.ssItemKey;else ssInventorySelection=button.dataset.ssItemKey;ssOpenItems(kind);};
 if(isBag){
  $('ssBagEquip').disabled=!selected||(selected.category==='tool'&&game.tool===selected.id);
  $('ssBagEquip').onclick=()=>{
   if(!selected)return;
   if(selected.category==='artifact'){characterTab='artifacts';characterMenu();return;}
   if(selected.category!=='tool')return;
   const ok=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
    if(!draft.unlockedTools.includes(selected.id)||draft.tool===selected.id)return false;
    draft.tool=selected.id;return true;
   });
   if(ok){holdLast=null;holdProgress=0;ssOpenItems('bag');flash('장착 완료');}
   else flash('장착할 수 없거나 저장에 실패했어요.');
  };
 }else $('ssInvSort').onclick=()=>{ssInventoryOrder=ssInventoryOrder==='default'?'name':ssInventoryOrder==='name'?'count':'default';ssOpenItems('inventory');};
}

function ssProfileModel(){
 const progress=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp);
 const depth=Math.max(0,Math.floor(p.y-terrain(p.x)));
 const place=placeInfo(depth,biomeAt(p.x));
 const stats=CHARACTER_STAT_IDS.map(id=>({id,name:CHARACTER_STAT_NAMES[id],points:Math.min(8,Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(game.character.stats[id])||0)))}));
 const tool=TOOL_INFO[game.tool]||TOOL_INFO.pickaxe;
 const trait=TRAIT_INFO[game.character.trait]||null;
 const slots=artifactSlotsFor(progress.level);
 const relics=Array.from({length:2},(_,i)=>{
  const unlocked=i<slots;
  const id=unlocked?game.artifactSystem.equippedIds[i]:null;
  return {unlocked,name:unlocked?(ARTIFACT_INFO[id]?.name||'비어 있음'):'Lv.12 해금',icon:unlocked?(ARTIFACT_INFO[id]?.icon||'＋'):'🔒'};
 });
 return {level:progress.level,place:place.label,sp:getUnspentSp(),tool,toolId:game.tool,forge:game.pickaxeForge.rank||0,skill:game.pickaxeLevel||1,trait:trait?.name||'미선택',stats,relics,ownedCount:game.artifactSystem.ownedIds.length};
}

 const relics=m.relics.map((item,i)=>`<div class="ss-gear-row"><span class="ss-gear-icon">${item.icon}</span><span>유물 ${i+1}</span><strong>${item.name}</strong></div>`).join('');
 showModal('광부 프로필',`<div class="ss-profile-head"><span class="ss-avatar"><span class="ss-navicon ss-miner" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><div><strong>광부</strong><span>Lv.${m.level} · ${m.place}</span><small>미사용 ${m.sp} SP</small></div></div><h3 class="ss-ui-subhead">능력치</h3><div class="ss-profile-stats">${rows}</div><h3 class="ss-ui-subhead">현재 착용</h3><div class="ss-gear-list"><div class="ss-gear-row"><span class="ss-gear-icon">${asset(m.tool.icon,'md')}</span><span>도구</span><strong>${m.tool.name} · Lv.${m.skill}</strong></div><div class="ss-gear-row"><span class="ss-gear-icon">✦</span><span>특성</span><strong>${m.trait}</strong></div>${relics}</div><div class="ss-ui-actions"><button id="ssProfileStats">성장</button><button id="ssProfileTraits">특성</button><button id="ssProfileBag">가방 열기</button></div>`);
 $('dialog').classList.add('ss-ui-modal','ss-profile-modal');$('backBtn').textContent='닫기';
 $('dialog').classList.remove('ss-inventory-modal','ss-settings-modal');
 for(const [btn,tab] of [['ssProfileStats','stats'],['ssProfileTraits','traits']])$(btn).onclick=()=>{characterTab=tab;characterMenu();};$('ssProfileBag').onclick=bagMenu;
}

 $('ropeHapticToggle').textContent=ropeHapticsEnabled?'켜짐':'꺼짐';$('ropeHapticToggle').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(ropeHapticsEnabled));
 $('ropeHapticToggle').onclick=()=>{ropeHapticsEnabled=!ropeHapticsEnabled;try{localStorage.setItem(ROPE_HAPTIC_KEY,ropeHapticsEnabled?'1':'0')}catch(_){}$('ropeHapticToggle').textContent=ropeHapticsEnabled?'켜짐':'꺼짐';$('ropeHapticToggle').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(ropeHapticsEnabled));if(ropeHapticsEnabled)ropeHaptic(8)};

 $('ssGameFullscreen').onclick=async()=>{

  try{if(document.fullscreenElement)await document.exitFullscreen();else if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen)await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();else{note.textContent='전체 화면을 지원하지 않는 브라우저예요.';return;}
   note.textContent=document.fullscreenElement?'전체 화면으로 전환했어요.':'전체 화면을 종료했어요.';
  }catch(_){note.textContent='브라우저에서 전체 화면을 허용하지 않았어요.';}
 };
 $('saveBtn').onclick=()=>saveGame();$('exportBtn').onclick=exportGame;$('importBtn').onclick=()=>$('fileImport').click();

// 2026-11-12: Hamburger option A. Anchored, scrollable section dropdown.
// No new persistence model: all destinations delegate to preexisting transactions/menus.
let ssHubWasPaused=false;
function ssHubIsOpen(){return !$('ssHub').hidden;}
function ssPositionHub(){
 if(!ssHubIsOpen())return;
 const app=$('app').getBoundingClientRect(),trigger=$('menuBtn').getBoundingClientRect();
 const width=Math.min(316,Math.max(240,app.width-20));
 const left=Math.max(8,Math.min(app.width-width-8,trigger.right-app.left-width));
 let top=Math.max(8,trigger.bottom-app.top+8);
 if(top>app.height-95)top=8; // small landscape viewport
 $('ssHub').style.left=Math.round(left)+'px';
 $('ssHub').style.top=Math.round(top)+'px';
 $('ssHub').style.width=Math.round(width)+'px';
 $('ssHub').style.maxHeight=Math.max(74,Math.floor(app.height-top-8))+'px';
}
function ssHubOpen(){
 if(ssIsTitle()||$('overlay').classList.contains('open'))return;
 ssHubWasPaused=paused;
 paused=true;
 input.left=input.right=input.jump=input.act=input.reelIn=input.reelOut=false;
 jumpBuffer=0;ropeHold=false;ropePointerAim=null;ropePreviewAnchor=null;ropeGestureFeedback();
 hudReleaseMine();stopMineStick();
 const progress=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp);
 $('ssHubSummary').textContent=`Lv.${progress.level} · ${game.coins} 코인`;
 $('ssHubSp').textContent=`${getUnspentSp()} SP`;
 $('ssHubTrait').textContent=TRAIT_INFO[game.character.trait]?.name||'미선택';
 $('ssHubArtifact').textContent=`${game.artifactSystem.equippedIds.length}/${artifactSlotsFor(progress.level)} 장착`;
 $('ssHubBackdrop').hidden=false;$('ssHub').hidden=false;
 $('menuBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
 ssPositionHub();
 $('ssHubClose').focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function ssHubClose(restoreFocus=false){
 if(!ssHubIsOpen())return;
 $('ssHub').hidden=true;$('ssHubBackdrop').hidden=true;
 $('menuBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
 paused=ssIsTitle()||$('overlay').classList.contains('open')||ssHubWasPaused;
 if(restoreFocus)$('menuBtn').focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function ssHubToggle(){if(ssHubIsOpen())ssHubClose(true);else ssHubOpen();}
function ssHubNavigate(target){
 if(!ssHubIsOpen())return;
 ssHubClose();
 switch(target){
  case 'profile': profileMenu();break;
  case 'stats': case 'traits': case 'artifacts': characterTab=target;characterMenu();break;
  case 'cargo': ssCargoMenu();break;
  case 'living': livingMenu();break;
  case 'settings': menu();break;
  case 'save': menu(true);break;
  case 'guide': ssQuickGuide();break;
  case 'rescue': if(confirm('마지막 안전 정거장으로 무료 이동할까요?'))rescuePlayer();break;
  case 'title': ssReturnToTitle();break;
 }
}
$('ssHubClose').onclick=()=>ssHubClose(true);
$('ssHubBackdrop').onclick=()=>ssHubClose();
for(const btn of $('ssHub').querySelectorAll('[data-ss-hub]'))btn.onclick=()=>ssHubNavigate(btn.dataset.ssHub);
window.addEventListener('resize',ssPositionHub);
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',ssPositionHub);

// Economy 2.14: one-write transaction semantics for market trades. No cross-request mutation.
const ORE_SALE_ITEMS=[['orecoal','석탄',5],['copper','구리',12],['iron','철',29],['crystal','수정',84],['titanium','티타늄',115],['starshard','별조각',285],['amber','호박석',135],['opal','오팔',220]];
function liftNeedsRepair(state=game){return !(state.transport&&Array.isArray(state.transport.unlocked)&&state.transport.unlocked.includes('quarry'));}
function liftReservedOreCount(id,state=game){
 if(id!=='copper'||!liftNeedsRepair(state)||!state.economy||!state.economy.reserveLiftMaterials)return 0;
 return Math.min(STATION_COST.copper,Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.inv.copper)||0)));
}
function nextForgeReservePlan(state=game){
 if(!state.economy?.reserveForgeMaterials)return [];
 const level=state.pickaxeForge?.rank||0;
 return FORGE_RULES[level+1]?.items||[];
}
function nextForgeReserveOreCount(id,state=game){
 const held=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.inv[id])||0));
 const lift=liftReservedOreCount(id,state);
 const wanted=nextForgeReservePlan(state).find(([type])=>type===id)?.[1]||0;
 return Math.min(wanted,Math.max(0,held-lift));
}
function reservedOreCount(id,state=game){
 return liftReservedOreCount(id,state)+nextForgeReserveOreCount(id,state);
}
function sellableOreCount(id,state=game){return Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.inv[id])||0)-reservedOreCount(id,state));}
function safeMarketTransaction(changeState){
 // Clone avoids accidental changes to the live world/inventory when localStorage rejects a write.
 let previous=game, draft;
 try{
  draft=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(previous));
  if(changeState(draft)!==true)return false;
  ssCargoReconcile(previous,draft);
  game=draft;
  if(!saveGame(true)){
   game=previous;
   updHud();
   flash('저장 실패: 거래가 취소됐어요. 저장 공간을 확인하거나 월드를 내보내세요.');
   return false;
  }
  updHud();
  return true;
 }catch(err){game=previous;saveOkay=false;updHud();flash('거래 중 오류가 발생해 변경을 취소했어요.');return false;}
}
// SANDSTAR 2.15-A: deterministic, one-write, no-break pickaxe forge.
// Existing pickaxeLevel (shared skill Lv1..6) remains independent from +0..+10.
const FORGE_RULES=[
 null,
 {cost:60,rate:100,items:[['stone',2]]},
 {cost:90,rate:100,items:[['stone',4]]},
 {cost:120,rate:100,items:[['copper',2]]},
 {cost:180,rate:90,items:[['copper',3]]},
 {cost:240,rate:80,items:[['iron',2]]},
 {cost:320,rate:70,items:[['iron',3]]},
 {cost:450,rate:60,items:[['iron',4],['orecoal',4]]},
 {cost:600,rate:50,items:[['crystal',1],['iron',3]]},
 {cost:800,rate:40,items:[['amber',1],['crystal',2]]},
 {cost:1100,rate:30,items:[['opal',1],['crystal',3]]}
];
const FORGE_MAX_RANK=10,FORGE_PITY_STEP=20,FORGE_BONUS_PER_RANK=.02;
let forgeTapLockUntil=0,ssForgeLastOutcome=null;
// 2.15-C: player-selected pickaxe affinity, never random. Works only when wielding the pickaxe.
const PICKAXE_AFFINITY_IDS=['earth','ore','scan'];
const PICKAXE_AFFINITY_INFO={
 earth:{name:'암쇄',short:'대지',description:'돌·석탄 채굴 특화',color:'#ddb38b'},
 ore:{name:'정광',short:'정밀',description:'광석 추가 획득 특화',color:'#8be7d2'},
 scan:{name:'탐맥',short:'공명',description:'근거리 광맥 탐지 특화',color:'#d2b5ff'}
};
const AFFINITY_SWAP_COST=120;
function equippedAffinity(state=game){
 const f=state.pickaxeForge;
 return state.tool==='pickaxe' && f && f.rank>=3 && PICKAXE_AFFINITY_IDS.includes(f.affinity)?f.affinity:'none';
}
function affinityIsAdvanced(state=game){return (state.pickaxeForge?.rank||0)>=7;}
function pickaxeAffinityPower(t,state=game){
 return equippedAffinity(state)==='earth'&&(t==='stone'||t==='orecoal')?(affinityIsAdvanced(state)?1.16:1.10):1;
}
function pickaxeOreBonusRate(state=game){
 return equippedAffinity(state)==='ore'?(affinityIsAdvanced(state)?.06:.03):0;
}
function pickaxeScanRadius(state=game){
 return equippedAffinity(state)==='scan'?(affinityIsAdvanced(state)?4:3):0;
}
function affinitySwitchCost(id,state=game){
 if(!PICKAXE_AFFINITY_IDS.includes(id) || (state.pickaxeForge?.rank||0)<3 || state.pickaxeForge.affinity===id)return null;
 // First-ever affinity selection is free; changes cost credits only. Lift repair supplies stay reserved.
 return state.pickaxeForge.affinity==='none'?0:AFFINITY_SWAP_COST;
}
function choosePickaxeAffinity(id){
 const cost=affinitySwitchCost(id);if(cost===null)return false;
 if(game.coins<cost){flash(`속성 교체에는 ${cost} 크레딧이 필요해요`);return false;}
 const success=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
  const required=affinitySwitchCost(id,draft);
  if(required===null || draft.coins<required)return false;
  draft.coins-=required;draft.economy.balanceMetrics.affinityCreditsSpent+=required;
  draft.pickaxeForge.affinity=id;
  draft.pickaxeForge.affinitySwitches=(draft.pickaxeForge.affinitySwitches||0)+1;
  return true;
 });
 if(success){forgeMenu();flash(`곡괭이 속성 ${PICKAXE_AFFINITY_INFO[id].name} 적용!`);playSound('pickup_ore');}
 return success;
}
function forgeAffinityPanel(){
 const f=game.pickaxeForge,unlocked=f.rank>=3,attr=f.affinity||'none',high=f.rank>=7;
 const current=attr==='none'?'미부여':PICKAXE_AFFINITY_INFO[attr].name;
 const effects={earth:high?'돌·석탄 채굴력 +16%':'돌·석탄 채굴력 +10%',ore:high?'광석 +1개 획득 확률 6%':'광석 +1개 획득 확률 3%',scan:high?'주변 4칸 광맥 강조':'주변 3칸 광맥 강조'};
 const options=PICKAXE_AFFINITY_IDS.map(id=>{
  const info=PICKAXE_AFFINITY_INFO[id],selected=attr===id,price=affinitySwitchCost(id);
  const disabled=!unlocked||selected||(price!==null&&game.coins<price);
  const action=selected?'사용 중':!unlocked?'잠금':price===0?'무료 부여':`${price}C 교체`;
  return `<button type="button" data-affinity="${id}" aria-pressed="${selected}" ${disabled?'disabled':''} aria-label="${info.name} 속성 ${action}"><b>${info.name}</b><small>${action}</small></button>`;
 }).join('');
 return `<section class="affinity-panel" aria-label="곡괭이 속성 전문화"><h4>⛏️ 곡괭이 속성 · ${unlocked?'활성':'강화 +3에서 해금'}</h4>
 <p class="affinity-status">현재: <strong>${current}</strong>${attr==='none'?'':` · ${effects[attr]}`}<br>${unlocked?'첫 부여 무료 · 교체 120C<br>+7 달성 시 상위 효과':'강화 +3을 달성하면 원하는 속성을 직접 선택할 수 있어요.'}</p>
 <div class="affinity-choices" role="group" aria-label="속성 선택">${options}</div>
 <p class="affinity-note">암쇄: ${effects.earth}<br>정광: ${effects.ore}<br>탐맥: ${effects.scan}<br>곡괭이 장착 시에만 효과 적용. 채굴 사거리는 광부 능력치에 따라 증가하고 시설 기초는 보호돼요.</p></section>`;
}
function normalizePickaxeForge(raw){
 const f=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
 const rank=Number.isSafeInteger(f.rank)?Math.max(0,Math.min(FORGE_MAX_RANK,f.rank)):0;
 const attemptCounter=Number.isSafeInteger(f.attemptCounter)&&f.attemptCounter>=0?f.attemptCounter:0;
 const streak=Number.isSafeInteger(f.failStreak)&&f.failStreak>=0?Math.min(4,f.failStreak):0;
 const affinity = rank>=3 && PICKAXE_AFFINITY_IDS.includes(f.affinity) ? f.affinity : 'none';
 const affinitySwitches=Number.isSafeInteger(f.affinitySwitches)&&f.affinitySwitches>=0?Math.min(f.affinitySwitches,99999999):0;
 const bonusOreDrops=Number.isSafeInteger(f.bonusOreDrops)&&f.bonusOreDrops>=0?Math.min(f.bonusOreDrops,99999999):0;
 return {rank,failStreak:rank>=FORGE_MAX_RANK||rank<=2?0:streak,attemptCounter,affinity,affinitySwitches,bonusOreDrops};
}
function forgeRule(state=game){return FORGE_RULES[(state.pickaxeForge?.rank||0)+1]||null;}
function forgeChance(state=game){const rule=forgeRule(state);return rule?Math.min(100,rule.rate+FORGE_PITY_STEP*(state.pickaxeForge?.failStreak||0)):100;}
function forgeReserved(item,state=game){
 if(!liftNeedsRepair(state)||!state.economy?.reserveLiftMaterials)return 0;
 if(item==='stone')return Math.min(STATION_COST.stone,Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.inv.stone)||0)));
 if(item==='copper')return liftReservedOreCount('copper',state);
 return 0;
}
function forgeAvailable(item,state=game){return Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.inv[item])||0)-forgeReserved(item,state));}
function forgeShortageReasons(state=game){
 const rule=forgeRule(state);if(!rule)return [];
 const reasons=[];
 if((state.coins||0)<rule.cost)reasons.push(`크레딧 ${state.coins||0}/${rule.cost}C (부족 ${rule.cost-(state.coins||0)}C)`);
 for(const [id,qty] of rule.items){
  const available=forgeAvailable(id,state);if(available>=qty)continue;
  const reserved=forgeReserved(id,state),held=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.inv?.[id])||0));
  reasons.push(`${MATERIAL_NAMES[id]} ${available}/${qty}개 (부족 ${qty-available}개${reserved?`, 보유 ${held}개 중 수리용 ${reserved}개 예약`:''})`);
 }
 return reasons;
}
function forgeCanAttempt(state=game){
 const rule=forgeRule(state), forge=state.pickaxeForge;
 if(!rule||!forge||!Number.isSafeInteger(forge.attemptCounter)||forge.attemptCounter===Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)return false;
 return Number.isSafeInteger(state.coins)&&state.coins>=rule.cost&&rule.items.every(([id,qty])=>forgeAvailable(id,state)>=qty);
}
function forgeRoll(state=game){
 const f=state.pickaxeForge;
 return hash(Math.imul(state.seed|0,1597334677)^Math.imul((f.attemptCounter+1)|0,1664525)^Math.imul((f.rank+1)|0,1103515245)^0x6a09e667);
}
function attemptPickaxeForge(){
 if(performance.now()<forgeTapLockUntil)return false;
 if(!forgeRule())return false;
 if(!forgeCanAttempt()){flash('강화 조건 미충족 · '+forgeShortageReasons().join(' / '));return false;}
 let outcome=null;
 const ok=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
  if(!forgeCanAttempt(draft))return false;
  const f=draft.pickaxeForge, rule=forgeRule(draft), chance=forgeChance(draft);
  const success=forgeRoll(draft)*100<chance;
  const nextRank=f.rank+1;
  if(success){
   draft.coins-=rule.cost;
   for(const [id,qty] of rule.items)draft.inv[id]-=qty;
   f.rank=nextRank;
   f.failStreak=0;
  }else{
   draft.coins-=Math.ceil(rule.cost/2);
   f.failStreak=Math.min(4,f.failStreak+1);
  }
  f.attemptCounter++;
  draft.economy.balanceMetrics.forgeAttempts++;
  draft.economy.balanceMetrics.forgeCreditsSpent+=success?rule.cost:Math.ceil(rule.cost/2);
  if(!success)draft.economy.balanceMetrics.forgeFailures++;
  outcome={success,stage:nextRank,charged:success?rule.cost:Math.ceil(rule.cost/2)};
  return true;
 });
 if(!ok)return false;
 forgeTapLockUntil=performance.now()+450;
 ssForgeLastOutcome={...outcome,rank:game.pickaxeForge.rank,coins:game.coins,nextChance:forgeChance()};
 forgeMenu();
 if(outcome.success){
  flash(`곡괭이 +${outcome.stage} 강화 성공! 채굴력 +${Math.round(game.pickaxeForge.rank*FORGE_BONUS_PER_RANK*100)}%`);
  playSound('pickup_ore');
 }else{
  flash(`강화 실패 · 단계 유지 · ${outcome.charged} 크레딧 소모\n다음 성공률 ${forgeChance()}%`);
  playSound('stone_hit');
 }
 return true;
}
function forgeMarketPanel(){
 const f=game.pickaxeForge,rule=forgeRule(),chance=forgeChance();
 const outcome=ssForgeLastOutcome;
 const result=outcome?`<div class="ss-forge-result" role="status" aria-live="polite"><strong>${outcome.success?`강화 성공! 곡괭이 +${outcome.rank}`:`강화 실패 · +${outcome.rank} 유지`}</strong><span>사용 ${outcome.charged}C · 남은 ${outcome.coins}C · ${outcome.success?'새 등급 반영 완료':`다음 성공률 ${outcome.nextChance}%`}</span></div>`:'';
 const shortages=forgeShortageReasons();
 const progress=Array.from({length:FORGE_MAX_RANK},(_,i)=>`<span class="${i<f.rank?'filled':''}" aria-hidden="true"></span>`).join('');
 if(!rule)return `<section class="forge-panel" aria-label="곡괭이 강화"><h3>곡괭이 전용 강화 +10</h3>${result}${forgeAppearancePanel(f.rank,null)}<div class="forge-progress">${progress}</div><p>최대 강화 달성! 현재 채굴력 보너스 +${Math.round(f.rank*FORGE_BONUS_PER_RANK*100)}%</p><p class="forge-hint">곡괭이 속성을 선택·교체할 수 있어요. 곡괭이 외형은 강화 단계에 따라 자동으로 바뀝니다. 기존 숙련도 강화는 독립적으로 유지됩니다.</p><button id="forgeAttempt" type="button" disabled>최대 강화 달성</button></section>`;
 const ingredients=rule.items.map(([id,qty])=>{
  const have=forgeAvailable(id),reserved=forgeReserved(id),pass=have>=qty;
  return `<span class="${pass?'held':'shortage'}">${MATERIAL_NAMES[id]} ${have}/${qty}${reserved?` (수리용 ${reserved} 보존)`:''}</span>`;
 }).join(' · ');
  const ready=forgeCanAttempt();
  // Show real before/after mining power against stone. Existing damage and costs unchanged.
  const pickaxeBase=62*(1+(Math.max(1,Math.min(6,game.pickaxeLevel||1))-1)*.28)*pickaxeAffinityPower('stone')*mobilityDerived().mineMultiplier;
  const powerBefore=pickaxeBase*(1+f.rank*FORGE_BONUS_PER_RANK);
  const powerAfter=pickaxeBase*(1+(f.rank+1)*FORGE_BONUS_PER_RANK);
  return `<section class="forge-panel" aria-label="곡괭이 강화">
  <h3>곡괭이 전용 강화 · +${f.rank} → +${f.rank+1}</h3>
  ${result}
  ${forgeAppearancePanel(f.rank,f.rank+1)}
  
  <div class="forge-progress" aria-label="강화 진행 ${f.rank}단계 / 10단계">${progress}</div>
  <div class="forge-metrics">
   <div class="forge-metric"><small>이번 시도 성공률</small><b>${chance}%</b><small>기본 ${rule.rate}% · 연속 실패 ${f.failStreak}회 (+${chance-rule.rate}%p)</small></div>
   <div class="forge-metric"><small>단계별 채굴력</small><b>+${Math.round(f.rank*2)}% → +${Math.round((f.rank+1)*2)}%</b><small>곡괭이만 적용 · 드릴/망치 영향 없음</small></div>
  </div>
  <p class="venue-caption">현재 캐릭터 기준 돌 채굴력 <strong>${powerBefore.toFixed(1)}</strong> → <strong>${powerAfter.toFixed(1)}</strong> (강화 시). 수치는 기존 강화 규칙 그대로예요.</p>
   <div class="forge-recipe">보유 <strong>${game.coins}C</strong> · 성공 시 <strong>${rule.cost}C</strong> · 실패 시 <strong>${Math.ceil(rule.cost/2)}C</strong><br>재료: ${ingredients}</div>
  ${shortages.length?`<div class="ss-forge-shortage" role="status">부족한 항목: ${shortages.join(' · ')}<br><small>수리용 재료가 예약됐다면 바람장터의 ‘보존’ 메뉴에서 확인할 수 있어요.</small></div>`:'<div class="ss-forge-ready">강화 재료와 크레딧 준비 완료</div>'}
  <button id="forgeAttempt" class="cta" type="button" ${ready?'':'disabled'} aria-label="곡괭이 +${f.rank+1} 강화 시도">${ready?`곡괭이 +${f.rank+1} 강화 도전`:'강화 재료·크레딧 부족'}</button>
  <div class="forge-hint">실패해도 강화 단계는 내려가지 않고 장비·재료는 사라지지 않아요. 실패마다 성공률 +20%p, 성공 시 보정 초기화. 저장 성공 후 거래 확정.</div>
 </section>`;
}
function sellOre(id,quantity){
 const entry=ORE_SALE_ITEMS.find(item=>item[0]===id);
 if(!entry)return false;
 const ok=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
  const available=sellableOreCount(id,draft);
  const amount=quantity==='all'?available:Math.min(available,quantity);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(amount)||amount<=0)return false;
  const value=amount*entry[2];
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(value)||!Number.isSafeInteger(draft.coins+value))return false;
  draft.inv[id]-=amount;draft.coins+=value;
  draft.economy.totalOreSold+=amount;draft.economy.totalCreditsEarned+=value;draft.economy.balanceMetrics.oreSold+=amount;draft.economy.balanceMetrics.creditsSold+=value;
  return true;
 });
 if(ok){market();flash(`${entry[1]} ${quantity==='all'?'전량':quantity+'개'} 판매 완료`);}else if(sellableOreCount(id)===0){flash('판매 가능한 광물이 없어요. 보존 재료를 확인하세요.');}
 return ok;
}
function sellAllOres(){
 let totalCount=0,totalCredit=0;
 const ok=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
  for(const [id,label,price] of ORE_SALE_ITEMS){
   const n=sellableOreCount(id,draft);if(n===0)continue;
   draft.inv[id]-=n;draft.coins+=n*price;
   totalCount+=n;totalCredit+=n*price;
  }
  if(totalCount<=0||!Number.isSafeInteger(draft.coins))return false;
  draft.economy.totalOreSold+=totalCount;draft.economy.totalCreditsEarned+=totalCredit;draft.economy.balanceMetrics.oreSold+=totalCount;draft.economy.balanceMetrics.creditsSold+=totalCredit;
  return Number.isSafeInteger(draft.economy.totalCreditsEarned);
 });
 if(ok){market();flash(`광물 ${totalCount}개 판매: +${totalCredit} 크레딧`);}else if(totalCount===0){flash('판매 가능한 광물이 없어요.');}
 return ok;
}
 function market(){
  if(!canOpenBuilding('market')){flash('바람장터 입구에서 이용할 수 있어요');return false;}
  const section=marketSection,remember=menuType==='바람장터'&&$('overlay').classList.contains('open')?$('dialog').scrollTop:0;
  const reserve=!!game.economy.reserveLiftMaterials,forgeReserve=!!game.economy.reserveForgeMaterials,pending=liftNeedsRepair();
  const forgeRuleNext=forgeRule();
  const available=ORE_SALE_ITEMS.reduce((acc,[id,,price])=>{const n=sellableOreCount(id);return {count:acc.count+n,value:acc.value+n*price};},{count:0,value:0});
  let content='';
  if(section==='sell'){
    const sales=ORE_SALE_ITEMS.map(([id,label,price])=>{
      const held=Math.floor(game.inv[id]||0),reserved=reservedOreCount(id),sellable=sellableOreCount(id);
      return `<div class="line market-item"><div class="market-meta"><strong>${label} <small>보유 ${held} · 판매 가능 ${sellable}${reserved?` · 예약 ${reserved}`:''}</small></strong><small>개당 ${price} C</small></div><div class="market-actions" role="group" aria-label="${label} 판매"><button type="button" data-sell="${id}" data-qty="1" ${sellable?'':'disabled'}>1개</button><button type="button" data-sell="${id}" data-qty="10" ${sellable?'':'disabled'}>${sellable>=10?'10개':`최대 ${sellable}`}</button><button type="button" data-sell="${id}" data-qty="all" ${sellable?'':'disabled'}>전량</button></div></div>`;
    }).join('');
    content=`<p class="venue-caption">예약된 재료는 자동으로 제외돼요. 거래는 저장 성공 후 확정돼요.</p><section class="line market-summary" aria-label="광물 일괄 판매"><strong>전체 광물 판매</strong><div class="market-hint">${available.count}개 판매 가능 · 예상 수익 <b>${available.value} C</b></div><div class="market-actions"><button id="sellAllBtn" ${available.count?'':'disabled'}>전체 광물 판매하기</button></div></section>${sales}`;
  }else if(section==='gear'){
    const tools=Object.entries(TOOL_INFO).map(([id,t])=>{const owned=game.unlockedTools.includes(id),equipped=game.tool===id;return `<div class="line"><div><strong>${asset(t.icon,'sm')} ${toolLabel(id)}</strong><br><small>${t.tag}${owned?' · 보유 중':` · ${t.price} C`}</small></div><button data-tool="${id}" ${equipped||(!owned&&game.coins<t.price)?'disabled':''}>${equipped?'사용 중':owned?'장착':'구매'}</button></div>`}).join('');
    content=`<p class="venue-caption">새 장비를 구매하거나 보유 장비를 장착할 수 있어요. 강화는 대장간에서 진행해요.</p>${tools}`;
  }else if(section==='reserve'){
    const c=liftReservedOreCount('copper');const text=forgeRuleNext?forgeRuleNext.items.map(([id,qty])=>`${MATERIAL_NAMES[id]} ${Math.min(qty,forgeAvailable(id))}/${qty}`).join(' · '):'곡괭이 최대 강화 완료';
    content=`<p class="venue-caption">필요한 광물은 보존하고, 남은 수량만 판매할 수 있어요.</p><div class="line reserve-row"><div><strong>승강장 수리 재료</strong><br><small>${pending?`돌 ${Math.min(game.inv.stone||0,8)}/8 · 구리 ${c}/3 예약`:'승강장 복구 완료'}</small></div><button id="reserveLiftBtn" ${pending?'':'disabled'} aria-pressed="${reserve}">${pending?(reserve?'보존 켜짐':'보존 꺼짐'):'수리 완료'}</button></div><div class="line balance-reserve"><div><strong>다음 곡괭이 강화 재료</strong><br><small>${text}</small></div><button id="reserveForgeBtn" ${forgeRuleNext?'':'disabled'} aria-pressed="${forgeReserve}">${forgeRuleNext?(forgeReserve?'보존 켜짐':'보존 꺼짐'):'강화 완료'}</button></div>`;
  }else{
    content='<p class="venue-caption">이 기기 월드 저장에만 보관되는 플레이 통계예요.</p>'+balanceMetricsMarkup();
  }
  const tabs=[['sell','판매','sell'],['gear','장비','gear'],['reserve','보존','reserve'],['stats','기록','stats']];
  venuePresent('바람장터',venueHeader('market','필요한 것만, 가볍게 거래하세요.')+venueTabs(tabs,section)+'<div class="venue-content">'+content+'</div>');
  $('dialog').scrollTop=remember;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{marketSection=btn.dataset.section;market();});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-sell]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>sellOre(btn.dataset.sell,btn.dataset.qty==='all'?'all':Number(btn.dataset.qty)));
  if($('sellAllBtn'))$('sellAllBtn').onclick=sellAllOres;
  if($('reserveLiftBtn'))$('reserveLiftBtn').onclick=()=>{const ok=safeMarketTransaction(d=>{d.economy.reserveLiftMaterials=!d.economy.reserveLiftMaterials;return true;});if(ok){market();flash(game.economy.reserveLiftMaterials?'수리 재료 보존 켜짐':'수리 재료 보존 꺼짐');}};
  if($('reserveForgeBtn'))$('reserveForgeBtn').onclick=()=>{const ok=safeMarketTransaction(d=>{if(!forgeRule(d))return false;d.economy.reserveForgeMaterials=!d.economy.reserveForgeMaterials;return true;});if(ok){market();flash(game.economy.reserveForgeMaterials?'강화 재료 보존 켜짐':'강화 재료 보존 꺼짐');}};

function canReach(x,y){

}

function burstMiningPixels(x,y,t,broken=false){
 const colors=MINE_COLORS[t]||MINE_COLORS.stone;
 const count=broken?Math.min(18,(t==='crystal'||t==='opal'||t==='relic')?14:9):3;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const a=(i/count)*Math.PI*2+(rand(x+i,y,671)-.5)*.5;
  const speed=broken?48+rand(x,y+i,672)*95:20+rand(x+i,y,674)*42;
  miningPixels.push({x:(x+.5)*T,y:(y+.5)*T,vx:Math.cos(a)*speed,vy:Math.sin(a)*speed-(broken?55:10),
   life:broken?.45+rand(x+i,y,676)*.26:.15+rand(x+i,y,677)*.15,
   maxLife:broken?.7:.3, color:colors[i%3], size:broken?2+(i%3):2});
 }

  orePulses.push({x:(x+.5)*T,y:(y+.5)*T,color:colors[2],life:t==='relic'?.68:.47,maxLife:t==='relic'?.68:.47});
  if(orePulses.length>8)orePulses.shift();
 }
}
function tickMiningPixels(dt){
 for(let i=miningPixels.length-1;i>=0;i--){const p=miningPixels[i];
  p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=175*dt;p.vx*=Math.pow(.22,dt);
  p.life-=dt;if(p.life<=0)miningPixels.splice(i,1);

}
function drawMiningPixels(){
 ctx.save();
 for(const o of miningPixels){const a=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,o.life/o.maxLife));
  ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.fillStyle=o.color;
  ctx.fillRect(Math.round(o.x-camera.x),Math.round(o.y-camera.y),o.size,o.size);
 }
 for(const o of orePulses){const t=1-o.life/o.maxLife,r=Math.round(5+t*15);
  const cx=Math.round(o.x-camera.x),cy=Math.round(o.y-camera.y);
  ctx.globalAlpha=.65*(1-t);ctx.strokeStyle=o.color;ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-r,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx-3,cy);
  ctx.moveTo(cx+3,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx+r,cy);
  ctx.moveTo(cx,cy-r);ctx.lineTo(cx,cy-3);
  ctx.moveTo(cx,cy+3);ctx.lineTo(cx,cy+r);ctx.stroke();
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

 else {

  const bonusChance=ORES.has(t)?pickaxeOreBonusRate():0;

 if(t==='bed'&&Math.floor(game.spawnX)===x){game.spawnX=SPAWN_X;game.spawnY=null}
 burstMiningPixels(x,y,t,true);playSound(t==='relic'||t==='crystal'||t==='titanium'||t==='starshard'||t==='amber'||t==='opal'?'rare_find':ORES.has(t)?'pickup_ore':'break_block');
 mineSpark(x,y,t,true);miningBreakFX={x,y,t,life:.28,maxLife:.28};miningHitFX=null;rangeHintTime=MINING_RANGE_HINT_TTL;shake=Math.min(6,shake+(t==='relic'?3:1.15));

  if(t==='amber'||t==='opal'||t==='crystal'||t==='titanium'||t==='starshard')flash(`${MATERIAL_NAMES[t]} 발견!`);
  else if(oreCombo===3||oreCombo===6)flash(`광맥 연속 발견 ${oreCombo}회!`);
 }
 if(!secondary&&game.tool==='hammer'){for(const [dx,dy] of [[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]){let tx=x+dx,ty=y+dy,tt=tile(tx,ty);if(!tt||tt==='bedrock'||tt==='stationrock'||tt==='bed'||tt==='chest'||tt==='relic'||!canReach(tx,ty))continue;
  const k=key(tx,ty),v=(splashDamage.get(k)||0)+tileHP(tt)*.4;if(v>=tileHP(tt)){splashDamage.delete(k);breakBlock(tx,ty,tt,true)}else splashDamage.set(k,v);if(splashDamage.size>80)splashDamage.clear();mineSpark(tx,ty,tt,false);
 }}

 return true;
}
function doMine(x,y,dmg){if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID)return false;let t=tile(x,y);if(!t||t==='bedrock'||t==='stationrock'||!canReach(x,y))return false;
 if(holdLast!==key(x,y)){holdLast=key(x,y);holdProgress=0;mineFXTimer=0}
 holdProgress+=dmg;
 mineFXTimer+=dmg/Math.max(1,miningRate(t));rangeHintTime=MINING_RANGE_HINT_TTL;if(mineFXTimer>.11){mineFXTimer=0;if(holdProgress<tileHP(t)){mineSpark(x,y,t,false);burstMiningPixels(x,y,t,false);playSound(miningSfxType(t),game.tool==='drill'?1.13:game.tool==='hammer'?.86:1);miningHitFX={x,y,t,life:.12,maxLife:.12}}}
 if(holdProgress>=tileHP(t)){holdProgress=0;holdLast=null;return breakBlock(x,y,t)}return false;
}
function tileAction(x,y,force=false){if(paused)return;if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID){ssMineNotice('마을 바닥은 보호되어 채굴할 수 없어요');return;}let t=tile(x,y);if(!canReach(x,y)){invalidReach={x,y,life:.65,maxLife:.65};rangeHintTime=.65;ssMineNotice(`사거리 밖 · 채굴 반경 ${effectiveMineReach().toFixed(2)}칸`,true);return}
 if(t==='stationrock'||t==='bedrock'){invalidReach={x,y,life:.55,maxLife:.55};rangeHintTime=.55;ssMineNotice(t==='stationrock'?'승강장·시설 바닥은 보호되어 채굴할 수 없어요':'기반암은 채굴할 수 없어요',true);return}
 if(!force&&t==='chest'){chestMenu(x,y);return}
 if(!force&&t==='bed'){game.spawnX=x;game.spawnY=y;flash('귀환 위치를 침대로 지정했어요');saveGame(true);return}
 if(t)doMine(x,y,force?miningRate(t)*.26:miningRate(t)*.18);
}
function miningTarget(){if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID)return null;if(holdTarget){let t=tile(holdTarget.x,holdTarget.y);return t&&t!=='bedrock'&&t!=='stationrock'&&canReach(holdTarget.x,holdTarget.y)?holdTarget:null}
 if(stickActive&&stickDir){const {dx,dy}=stickDir,scale=Math.hypot(dx,dy);const seen=new Set();
  for(let dist=.3;dist<=effectiveMineReach()+.25;dist+=.12){const x=Math.floor(p.x+dx/scale*dist),y=Math.floor(p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET+dy/scale*dist),k=key(x,y);
   if(seen.has(k))continue;seen.add(k);const t=tile(x,y);
   if(t&&t!=='bedrock'&&t!=='bed'&&t!=='chest'&&t!=='stationrock'&&canReach(x,y))return {x,y};
    if((t==='stationrock'||t==='bedrock')&&canReach(x,y)){ssMineNotice(t==='stationrock'?'시설 바닥은 보호되어 채굴할 수 없어요':'기반암은 채굴할 수 없어요');return null;}
  }
  return null;
 }
 if(!input.act)return null;
 let fx=Math.floor(p.x+p.facing*1.08),fy=Math.floor(p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET),me=Math.floor(p.x);
 let checks=[[fx,fy],[fx,fy-1],[fx,fy+1],[Math.floor(p.x+p.facing*2.08),fy],[me,Math.floor(p.y+.05)],[me,fy-2]];
 for(const [x,y] of checks){let t=tile(x,y);if(t&&t!=='bedrock'&&t!=='bed'&&t!=='chest'&&canReach(x,y))return {x,y}}return null;
}
function mineHold(dt){let target=miningTarget();if(!target)return;let t=tile(target.x,target.y);if(!t)return;balanceStats().miningSeconds+=dt;doMine(target.x,target.y,dt*miningRate(t))}
function collides(x,y){let l=x-PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH,r=x+PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH,t=y-PLAYER_HEIGHT,b=y-.04;for(let tx=Math.floor(l);tx<=Math.floor(r);tx++)for(let ty=Math.floor(t);ty<=Math.floor(b);ty++){if(solid(tile(tx,ty)))return true}return false}
function moveStep(dx,dy){if(dx){let n=Math.ceil(Math.abs(dx)/.14);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let d=dx/n;if(!collides(p.x+d,p.y))p.x+=d;else {if(input.left||input.right)ssMineNotice('이동이 막혔어요 · 앞의 블록을 채굴하거나 다른 길로 이동하세요');p.vx=0;break}}}
 if(dy){let n=Math.ceil(Math.abs(dy)/.14);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let d=dy/n;if(!collides(p.x,p.y+d))p.y+=d;else {if(d>0)p.grounded=true;p.vy=0;break}}}}
// A shaft may have a clear exit but no suitable solid anchor three tiles above.
// Use a real, unprotected bank tile beside the lip; every player move is collision-checked.
function ropeSurfaceExitPlan(){
 if(!p||paused)return null;
 const column=Math.floor(p.x),surfaceY=terrain(column),depth=p.y-surfaceY;
 if(depth<-.5||depth>6.65)return null;
 const directions=input.left?[-1,1]:[1,-1];
 for(const side of directions){
  const landingX=column+.5+side*1.08;
  // Actual top bank includes the generated grass tile above terrain().
  let groundY=null;
  for(let y=Math.max(1,terrain(landingX)-4);y<=terrain(landingX)+2;y++){
   if(solid(tile(Math.floor(landingX),y))){groundY=y;break;}
  }
  if(groundY===null||Math.abs(groundY-surfaceY)>2.5)continue;
  const bankTile=tile(Math.floor(landingX),groundY);
  if(!solid(bankTile)||bankTile==='stationrock'||bankTile==='bedrock')continue;
  const exitY=Math.min(surfaceY-1.35,groundY-.35);
  if(!Number.isFinite(exitY)||exitY<1||collides(landingX,exitY))continue;
  // A narrow shaft must be genuinely open all the way up. No phase-through mining.
  let clear=true;
  for(let y=p.y;y>=exitY;y-=.10){if(collides(p.x,y)){clear=false;break;}}
  if(!clear||collides(p.x,exitY))continue;
  const n=Math.ceil(Math.abs(landingX-p.x)/.1);
  for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)if(collides(p.x+(landingX-p.x)*i/n,exitY)){clear=false;break;}
  if(!clear)continue;
  return {surfaceY,exitY,landingX,groundY,anchor:{x:Math.floor(landingX),y:groundY,
   faceX:column+(side>0?1:0),faceY:groundY}};
 }
 return null;
}
function finishRopeSurfaceExit(){
 const plan=rope.surfaceExitPlan;
 if(!plan||Math.abs(p.y-plan.exitY)>.1)return false;
 const beforeX=p.x;
 moveStep(plan.landingX-p.x,0);
 if(Math.abs(p.x-plan.landingX)>.07){p.x=beforeX;flash('지표 턱이 막혀 있어요. 방향을 바꿔주세요');return false;}
 noteRopeAscent();releaseRope();p.vx=0;p.vy=0;p.grounded=false;
 flash('로프를 타고 지표 가장자리로 올라왔어요');return true;
}
// Contextual rope grapple: the old vertical anchor rule stays unchanged unless

function cutRopeJump(){
 // Jump during rope ascent or hanging: visibly sever the cable and propel upwards.
 if(!rope.active)return false;
 const anchor=rope.anchor;
 if(anchor){

function ropeSightOK(faceX,faceY){let sx=p.x,sy=p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET;for(let i=1;i<20;i++){

// 2.18-F: aim in a cone, stop on the first real solid surface, and validate

function findDirectionalRopeAnchor(direction){
 const base=ROPE_FIRE_DIRECTIONS[direction];
 if(!base||paused||!p)return null;
 const sx=p.x,sy=p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET;
 for(const spread of (direction==='left'||direction==='right'?[0,-5,5]:[0,-7,7,-14,14])){
  const rad=spread*Math.PI/180,ux=base[0]*Math.cos(rad)-base[1]*Math.sin(rad),uy=base[0]*Math.sin(rad)+base[1]*Math.cos(rad);
  const visited=new Set();
  for(let dist=.2;dist<=11.2;dist+=.12){
   const ix=Math.floor(sx+ux*dist),iy=Math.floor(sy+uy*dist),k=ix+','+iy;
   if(visited.has(k))continue;visited.add(k);
   const t=tile(ix,iy);
   if(!solid(t))continue;
   // A protected surface cannot become a rope transport shortcut.
   if(t==='bedrock'||t==='stationrock'||t==='bed'||t==='chest')break;
   if(dist<2.2)break;
   const entryX=Math.abs(ux)>1e-6?(ux>0?(ix-sx)/ux:(ix+1-sx)/ux):-Infinity;
   const entryY=Math.abs(uy)>1e-6?(uy>0?(iy-sy)/uy:(iy+1-sy)/uy):-Infinity;
   const side=entryX>=entryY;
   const faceX=side?(ux>0?ix:ix+1):Math.max(ix+.08,Math.min(ix+.92,sx+ux*entryY));
   const faceY=side?Math.max(iy+.08,Math.min(iy+.92,sy+uy*entryX)):(uy>0?iy:iy+1);

   if(targetX<1||targetX>WW-2||targetY<1||targetY>WH-2||collides(targetX,targetY))break;
   let clear=true;
   const journey=Math.hypot(targetX-p.x,targetY-p.y),steps=Math.ceil(journey/.13);

function fireDirectionalRope(direction){

 if(direction==='up'){toggleRope();return rope.active;}
 if(!ROPE_FIRE_DIRECTIONS[direction])return false;
 const a=findDirectionalRopeAnchor(direction);
 if(!a){flash('그 방향에는 연결 가능한 암벽이나 빈 이동 통로가 없어요');return false;}
 if(chaining){
  ropeChainRemaining--;ropeChainWindow=0;ropeGrabCooldown=0;

 }else{rope={active:true,anchor:a,targetX:a.targetX,targetY:a.targetY,attached:false,mode:'pull'};ropeChainWindow=0;}

// 2.18-G: Explicit swing from a completed directional pull. Never change a
// vertical rope or a partially completed pull until the player presses left/right.
function startRopeSwing(direction){

// 2.18-H: change swing-line length without jumping through solid terrain.

// A taut, inextensible cable with soft gravity and tangential input.
// Each step checks the original tile collider before applying rope tension.
function updateRopeSwing(dt,dir){

 if(!solid(tile(a.x,a.y))){releaseRope();flash('암벽이 사라져 로프가 풀렸어요');return;}

 if(!Number.isFinite(len)||len<1.6){releaseRope();return;}

 const step=dt/substeps;
 for(let i=0;i<substeps;i++){
  const rx=p.x-ox,ry=p.y-PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET-oy,rad=Math.hypot(rx,ry);

    }

   }else{releaseRope();flash('스윙 경로가 막혀 로프가 풀렸어요');return;}
   const outward=p.vx*ux+p.vy*uy;

function moveCamera(dt){camera.x+=(p.x*T-viewW*.5-camera.x)*Math.min(1,dt*5.3);

function updatePhysics(dt){

 ropeChainWindow=Math.max(0,ropeChainWindow-dt);

  ropeAim=dir;
  if(jumpBuffer>0){cutRopeJump();input.jump=false;jumpBuffer=0;}
  else if(!solid(tile(rope.anchor.x,rope.anchor.y))){releaseRope();airLeapControl=false;flash('암벽이 사라져 로프가 풀렸어요');}

   // 2.18-F directional pulls remain stationary when attached; movement input

   }

   if(rope.mode==='pull'){

    }

    if(p.y>prev-.005){releaseRope();airLeapControl=false;flash('위쪽 통로가 막혀 로프가 풀렸어요')}}
   else {p.y=rope.targetY;if(!rope.attached){rope.attached=true;noteRopeAscent();}}

 const onFloor=collides(p.x,p.y+.055);
 p.grounded=onFloor;
 if(onFloor){airLeapControl=false;coyoteTime=COYOTE_WINDOW;}
 else coyoteTime=Math.max(0,coyoteTime-dt);
 if(jumpBuffer>0&&coyoteTime>0){p.vy=-mobilityDerived().jumpImpulse;p.grounded=false;input.jump=false;jumpBuffer=0;coyoteTime=0;}
 const target=dir*mobilityDerived().moveSpeed*ssCargoMoveFactor();
 const accel=onFloor?(dir?39:55):(airLeapControl?(dir?27:17):(dir?19:12));
 p.vx=approach(p.vx,target,accel*dt);

 p.vy=Math.min(14.5,p.vy+23*dt);

 if(ropeLeapLedgePlan){

  if(p.vy<0&&p.y<=plan.exitY+.03){
   if(!dir){
    moveStep(plan.landingX-p.x,0);
    if(Math.abs(p.x-plan.landingX)<=.07){p.vx=0;ropeLeapLedgePlan=null;flash('도약 후 지표 가장자리에 착지할 수 있어요');}
   }else{ropeLeapLedgePlan=null;} // respect explicit player steering
  }
  if(ropeLeapLedgePlan&&(p.grounded||(p.vy>0&&p.y>plan.surfaceY+1.5)))ropeLeapLedgePlan=null;
 }
 if(p.x<1){p.x=1;p.vx=Math.max(0,p.vx)}
 if(p.x>WW-2){p.x=WW-2;p.vx=Math.min(0,p.vx)}
 if(collides(p.x,p.y+.055)&&p.vy>=0){p.grounded=true;airLeapControl=false;coyoteTime=COYOTE_WINDOW;}
 refillRopeLeapsOnGround(dt);
 moveCamera(dt);
}

// Lift stations: two discoveries in a continuous world, not fixed numbered floors.
function transportState(){return game.transport}
function stationById(id){return STATION_DATA.find(x=>x.id===id)||STATION_DATA[0]}
function closestStation(){if(ssRegion!=='mine')return null;let best=null,distance=Infinity;for(const station of STATION_DATA){let d=Math.hypot(p.x-station.x,(p.y-.4)-(station.foot-.5));if(d<distance){best=station;distance=d}}return distance<=5.4?best:null}
function rememberStation(station){const tr=transportState();if(!tr.discovered.includes(station.id)){
 tr.discovered.push(station.id);saveGame(true);flash(station.name+' 발견! 승강장을 살펴보세요');}
 if(tr.unlocked.includes(station.id))tr.lastSafeId=station.id;}
function updateMobilityHud(){nearbyStation=closestStation();if(nearbyStation)rememberStation(nearbyStation);
  const lift=$('stationAction'),shelter=closestShelter(),building=nearbyStation||shelter?null:closestBuilding();
  lift.classList.toggle('visible',!!(nearbyStation||building||shelter));lift.classList.toggle('building-context',!!building);lift.classList.toggle('shelter-context',!!shelter);
   if(shelter){lift.textContent='⌂ 쉼터 휴식';lift.setAttribute('aria-label','가까운 지하 쉼터에서 휴식하고 저장하기');}
   else if(nearbyStation){lift.innerHTML=`${asset('station','md')}<span>${transportState().unlocked.includes(nearbyStation.id)?'승강장 이동':'승강장 수리'}</span>`;lift.setAttribute('aria-label','승강장 이용');}
  else if(building){lift.innerHTML=`${shopIcon(building.id==='forge'?'forge':'sell')}<span>${building.name} 입장</span>`;lift.setAttribute('aria-label',building.name+' 입장');}

 if(!rope.active)ropeCandidate=ropeGrabCooldown>0?null:findRopeAnchor();
 const jumpButton=$('jump'),boostReady=rope.active&&remainingRopeLeaps()>0;
 jumpButton.classList.toggle('ropeboost',boostReady);
 $('jumpLabel').textContent=rope.active?`도약 ${remainingRopeLeaps()}/${mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax}`:'점프';
 jumpButton.setAttribute('aria-label',rope.active?`로프 도약 남은 횟수 ${remainingRopeLeaps()}회, 최대 ${mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax}회`:'점프');
 const b=$('ropeBtn');
 b.classList.add('visible');b.classList.toggle('attached',rope.active);b.disabled=false;
 b.innerHTML=`<img class="duri-rope-coil" alt="" aria-hidden="true" src="data:image/png;base64,"><span class="duri-rope-label">${rope.active?(rope.attached?(rope.mode==='swing'?`줄 ${rope.swingLength.toFixed(1)}↕`:rope.mode==='pull'?'좌우: 스윙':'이어서'):'이동 중'):(ropePointerAim?.direction==='up'?'로프':ropePointerAim?.direction?'조준 중':'로프')}</span>`;
 b.setAttribute('aria-label',rope.active?(rope.mode==='swing'?`스윙 중. 줄 길이 ${rope.swingLength.toFixed(1)}칸, 공중 연결 ${ropeChainRemaining}회. 버튼 위아래 드래그로 길이 조절, 좌우 드래그로 앵커 교체, 점프로 로프 절단`:'누르면 로프 해제; 위아래 드래그로 감기 또는 풀기, 좌우 드래그로 다른 암벽 연결'):`짧게 터치해 자동 상승, 드래그해 방향 발사. 공중 연결 남은 횟수 ${ropeChainRemaining}회`);
 jumpButton.dataset.aim=rope.active&&boostReady?(ropeAim<0?'left':ropeAim>0?'right':'up'):'up';
}
function stationMenu(){const station=closestStation();if(!station){flash('승강장 근처에서 이용할 수 있어요');return}
 rememberStation(station);let tr=transportState(),unlocked=tr.unlocked.includes(station.id);
 let costLabel=`돌 ${STATION_COST.stone}개 · 구리 ${STATION_COST.copper}개 · ${STATION_COST.coins} 크레딧`;
 let canPay=(game.inv.stone||0)>=STATION_COST.stone&&(game.inv.copper||0)>=STATION_COST.copper&&game.coins>=STATION_COST.coins;
 let rows=STATION_DATA.map(s=>{let found=tr.discovered.includes(s.id),active=tr.unlocked.includes(s.id),current=s.id===station.id;
 return `<div class="line"><div><strong>${found?s.name:'??? 미발견 정거장'}</strong><br><small>${current?'현재 위치 · ':''}${active?'개방됨':found?'수리 필요':'탐험해서 발견하세요'}</small></div><button data-dest="${s.id}" ${!active||current?'disabled':''}>${current?'현재 역':'이동'}</button></div>`}).join('');
 let repair=unlocked?'':`<div class="line"><div><strong>${asset('station','sm')} 승강장 복구</strong><br><small>${costLabel}</small><br><small>현재: 돌 ${game.inv.stone||0} · 구리 ${game.inv.copper||0} · 크레딧 ${game.coins}</small></div><button class="cta" id="repairLift" ${canPay?'':'disabled'}>수리</button></div>`;
 showModal(station.name,`<p>정거장을 발견하고 복구하면 다른 개방된 정거장까지 이동할 수 있어요. 직접 탐험한 지역만 이동망에 등록됩니다.</p>${repair}${rows}<p class="note">승강장 이용료 없음 · 미발견 지역은 바로 이동할 수 없음 · 긴급 구조는 ☰ 전체 메뉴에서 무료로 사용 가능</p>`);
 if(!unlocked)$('repairLift').onclick=()=>{
  const ok=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
   if((draft.inv.stone||0)<STATION_COST.stone||(draft.inv.copper||0)<STATION_COST.copper||draft.coins<STATION_COST.coins)return false;
   if(!draft.transport||!Array.isArray(draft.transport.unlocked)||draft.transport.unlocked.includes(station.id))return false;
   draft.inv.stone-=STATION_COST.stone;draft.inv.copper-=STATION_COST.copper;draft.coins-=STATION_COST.coins;
   draft.transport.unlocked.push(station.id);draft.transport.lastSafeId=station.id;return true;
  });
  if(ok){stationMenuRefresh(station);flash(station.name+' 개방!');}
 };
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-dest]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>travelStation(el.dataset.dest));
}

 }return null;}

 setEnabled:(on)=>{duriOrePreviewEnabled=!!on;try{localStorage.setItem(DURI_ORE_VISUAL_PREF,duriOrePreviewEnabled?'1':'0')}catch(_){}return duriOrePreviewEnabled},
 preview:duriOreGallery,visualOnly:false

/* 2.18-H3 shelter P0: quarry shelter supports local rest/checkpoint save; three other facility sprites remain decorative. */
const DURI_FACILITY_ASSETS=Object.freeze({"station_shelter": "data:image/png;base64,", "wall_lantern": "data:image/png;base64,", "oxygen_capsule": "data:image/png;base64,", "safety_net": "data:image/png;base64,"});
const duriFacilityImages=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(DURI_FACILITY_ASSETS).map(([name,raw])=>{
 const img=new Image();img.src=raw;return [name,img];
}));
const DURI_FACILITY_PREVIEW_KEY='sandstar-duri-facilities-preview-v1'; // Toggle affects the remaining decorative sprites; shelter remains visible.
let duriFacilitiesVisible=true;
try{duriFacilitiesVisible=localStorage.getItem(DURI_FACILITY_PREVIEW_KEY)!=='0'}catch(_){}
function duriFacilityPlacements(){
 const st=STATION_DATA.find(v=>v.id==='quarry');if(!st)return [];
 const sx=st.x,base=st.foot;
 return [
  {id:'station_shelter',x:sx-4.3,foot:base,w:76,h:76,label:'지하 쉼터'},
  {id:'wall_lantern',x:sx-3.35,foot:base-2.1,w:24,h:24,label:'벽걸이 랜턴'},
  {id:'oxygen_capsule',x:sx+3.15,foot:base,w:26,h:39,label:'산소 캡슐'},
  {id:'safety_net',x:sx+1.85,foot:base,w:56,h:30,label:'안전망'}
 ];
}
function drawDuriFacilities(){
  if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID)return;
  ctx.save();ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  for(const item of duriFacilityPlacements()){
   if(!duriFacilitiesVisible&&item.id!=='station_shelter')continue;
  const img=duriFacilityImages[item.id];if(!img||!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth)continue;
  const sx=Math.round(item.x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.round(item.foot*T-camera.y-item.h);
  if(sx>viewW+item.w||sx+item.w<0||sy>viewH+item.h||sy+item.h<0)continue;
  ctx.drawImage(img,sx,sy,item.w,item.h);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
// Local-only shelter P0: use the existing station proximity UX, no remote save or health economy.
function closestShelter(){
  if(ssRegion!=='mine')return null;
  if(!p)return null;
  const place=duriFacilityPlacements().find(item=>item.id==='station_shelter');if(!place)return null;
  const centerX=place.x+(place.w/T)*.5;
  return Math.abs(p.x-centerX)<=2.15&&Math.abs(p.y-place.foot)<=1.65?place:null;
}
function shelterTileHit(q){
  const a=duriFacilityPlacements().find(item=>item.id==='station_shelter');
  return !!a&&q.x+.5>=a.x&&q.x+.5<=a.x+a.w/T&&q.y+.5>=a.foot-a.h/T&&q.y+.5<=a.foot;
}
function shelterRestReady(){
  return !!(closestShelter()&&!rope.active&&!collides(p.x,p.y)&&collides(p.x,p.y+.055));
}
function shelterMenu(){
  if(!closestShelter()){flash('지하 쉼터 가까이에서 이용할 수 있어요');return false;}
  const meta=normalizeShelterState(game.shelter),ready=shelterRestReady();
  const last=meta.lastRestAt?new Date(meta.lastRestAt).toLocaleString('ko-KR'):'없음';
  showModal('지하 쉼터',`<p>바위굴 정거장 옆 쉼터예요. 휴식하면 로프 도약·연결 사용권을 회복하고 현재 위치와 진행 상황을 <b>이 브라우저에 저장</b>합니다.</p>
   <div class="line"><div><strong>휴식 기록</strong><br><small>휴식 ${meta.restCount}회 · 최근 ${last}</small></div></div>
   <div class="stack"><button class="cta" id="shelterRestBtn" ${ready?'':'disabled'}>휴식하고 저장</button><button id="shelterSaveBtn">진행만 저장</button></div>
   <p class="note">${ready?'지금 휴식할 수 있어요.':'휴식하려면 쉼터 앞 안전한 바닥에 착지해야 해요.'}<br>체력·산소 회복 기능은 아직 없습니다. 자동 백업·서버 저장이 아니라 기존 로컬 저장소에 기록됩니다. 파일 백업은 메뉴의 [월드 파일 내보내기]를 이용하세요.</p>`);
  $('shelterRestBtn').onclick=restAtShelter;
  $('shelterSaveBtn').onclick=()=>{if(!closestShelter()){flash('쉼터에서 멀어졌어요');return;}if(!saveGame(true)){flash('저장이 실패했어요. 메뉴에서 파일로 내보내세요.');return;}closeModal();flash('쉼터에서 현재 진행 상황을 저장했어요 ✓');};
  return true;
}
function restAtShelter(){
  if(!shelterRestReady()){flash('쉼터 앞 바닥에 착지한 뒤 휴식할 수 있어요');return false;}
  const prev=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(game)),old={vx:p.vx,vy:p.vy,fall:p.fall,charges:ropeLeapRemaining,chain:ropeChainRemaining,groundSeconds:ropeGroundStableSeconds};
  const next=normalizeShelterState(game.shelter);next.restCount=Math.min(1000000,next.restCount+1);next.lastRestAt=new Date().toISOString();next.lastRestX=p.x;next.lastRestY=p.y;
  game.shelter=next;p.vx=p.vy=0;p.fall=0;ropeLeapRemaining=mobilityDerived().ropeLeapMax;ropeChainRemaining=ROPE_CHAIN_MAX;ropeGroundStableSeconds=.08;
  if(!saveGame(true)){
    game=prev;p.vx=old.vx;p.vy=old.vy;p.fall=old.fall;ropeLeapRemaining=old.charges;ropeChainRemaining=old.chain;ropeGroundStableSeconds=old.groundSeconds;
    flash('저장이 차단되어 휴식도 취소했어요. 월드 파일 백업을 이용하세요.');return false;
  }
  closeModal();updHud();flash('쉼터에서 휴식 완료 · 로프 회복 · 현재 위치 저장 ✓');return true;
}
function duriFacilityGallery(){
 const entries=[['station_shelter','지하 쉼터','근처에서 휴식·진행 저장 가능 (체력/산소 회복 없음)'],['wall_lantern','벽걸이 랜턴','장식, 조명 효과 없음'],['oxygen_capsule','산소 캡슐','장식, 산소 회복 기능 없음'],['safety_net','안전망','장식, 추락 피해 감소 없음']];
 const html='<p>두리 지하시설 4종을 <b>바위굴 정거장 주변</b>에 배치했습니다. 쉼터는 휴식·로프 도약 회복·진행 저장을 지원하며, 나머지 3종은 장식입니다. 체력·산소·안전망 효과는 없습니다.</p>'+entries.map(([k,label,note])=>
  '<div class="line"><img src="'+DURI_FACILITY_ASSETS[k]+'" style="width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated" alt="'+label+'"><div><b>'+label+'</b><br><small>'+note+'</small></div></div>').join('');
 showModal('두리 지하시설 미리보기',html);

window.__sandstarShelter={near:()=>!!closestShelter(),ready:shelterRestReady,refresh:updHud,open:shelterMenu,rest:restAtShelter,state:()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(normalizeShelterState(game.shelter)))};
 window.__sandstarDuriFacilities={get:()=>({enabled:duriFacilitiesVisible,ready:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(duriFacilityImages).map(([k,i])=>[k,i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0])),placements:duriFacilityPlacements()}),setEnabled:(on)=>{duriFacilitiesVisible=!!on;try{localStorage.setItem(DURI_FACILITY_PREVIEW_KEY,duriFacilitiesVisible?'1':'0')}catch(_){}return duriFacilitiesVisible},preview:duriFacilityGallery};
// SANDSTAR M1 separate forest view. All art is drawn procedurally; no external resources.
function drawM1ForestWorld(){
 const left=Math.max(11,Math.floor(camera.x/T)-2),right=Math.min(146,Math.ceil((camera.x+viewW)/T)+2);
 const low=Math.max(0,Math.floor(camera.y/T)-2),high=Math.min(WH-1,Math.ceil((camera.y+viewH)/T)+2);
 ctx.save();
 // Far canopy and hazy treeline make this biome feel distinct from the mine.
 for(let x=left-4;x<=right+4;x+=5){const sx=Math.round(x*T-camera.x),gy=ssM1ForestTerrain(x)*T-camera.y;
  ctx.globalAlpha=.32;ctx.fillStyle='#3c8b7b';ctx.fillRect(sx-13,gy-255,44,250);
  ctx.fillStyle='#35765b';ctx.fillRect(sx-31,gy-280,78,65);ctx.fillRect(sx-16,gy-310,52,50);
 }
 ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 for(let y=low;y<=high;y++)for(let x=left;x<=right;x++){
  const id=tile(x,y);if(!id)continue;
  const sx=Math.round(x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.round(y*T-camera.y);
  ctx.drawImage(sprite(id,(x*3+y*7)&3),sx,sy,T+1,T+1);
  if(y===ssM1ForestTerrain(x)-1){ctx.fillStyle='#8bb969';ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,27,3);}
 }
 // Stream and reeds; shallow water is visual in M1, not a full fluid system.
 for(let x=61;x<=70;x++){
  const sx=Math.round(x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.round((ssM1ForestTerrain(x)-1)*T-camera.y);
  if(sx<-T||sx>viewW+T)continue;
  ctx.fillStyle=game.storyM1.springRepaired?'#3b9fb4':'#416a79';ctx.fillRect(sx,sy+T-10,T+1,10);
  ctx.fillStyle=game.storyM1.springRepaired?'#88e7d9':'#718e98';ctx.fillRect(sx+4,sy+T-9,14,2);
  if(x%3===0){ctx.fillStyle='#8bbd76';ctx.fillRect(sx,sy+5,3,9);}
 }
 // Handbuilt portal gate, and the sealed spring far upstream.
 ssM1DrawLandmark(M1_FOREST_GATE_X,'portal',!game.storyM1.springRepaired);
 ssM1DrawLandmark(M1_FOREST_SPRING_X,'spring',!game.storyM1.springRepaired);
 // Farm sign and small village edge, apart from the original tile system.
 const gx=Math.round(36*T-camera.x),gy=Math.round((ssM1ForestTerrain(36)-1)*T-camera.y);
 if(gx>-100&&gx<viewW+100){ctx.fillStyle='#7d5237';ctx.fillRect(gx-22,gy-41,4,46);ctx.fillRect(gx-40,gy-42,63,20);ctx.fillStyle='#fce7b1';ctx.font='bold 12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('솔아의 밭',gx-9,gy-27)}
 const fx=Math.round(87*T-camera.x),fy=Math.round((ssM1ForestTerrain(87)-1)*T-camera.y);
 if(fx>-100&&fx<viewW+100){ctx.fillStyle='#8c593e';ctx.fillRect(fx,fy-32,6,38);ctx.fillRect(fx-18,fy-35,48,17);ctx.fillStyle='#fff1be';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('잔빛 숲길',fx+7,fy-23)}
 ctx.restore();
}
function ssM1DrawLandmark(x,type,dry){
 const sx=Math.round(x*T-camera.x),y=Math.round((terrain(x)-1)*T-camera.y);
 if(sx<-110||sx>viewW+110)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';
 if(type==='portal'){
  ctx.fillStyle='#634a3a';ctx.fillRect(sx-18,y-81,9,86);ctx.fillRect(sx+30,y-81,9,86);ctx.fillRect(sx-18,y-81,57,12);
  ctx.fillStyle='#b0dbab';ctx.fillRect(sx-12,y-71,45,6);ctx.fillStyle='#ffefd0';ctx.fillText('← 도래마을',sx+12,y-90);
 }else{
  ctx.fillStyle='#756e5a';ctx.fillRect(sx-40,y-16,96,19);ctx.fillStyle='#aaa98d';ctx.fillRect(sx-32,y-20,80,8);
  const glow=.7+Math.sin(frame*.075)*.3;
  ctx.globalAlpha=glow;ctx.fillStyle=dry?'#7691a5':'#85e9df';ctx.fillRect(sx-6,y-55,20,36);ctx.fillStyle=dry?'#8f98ae':'#e3ffe3';ctx.fillRect(sx-2,y-63,12,11);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle='#f8f2c0';ctx.fillText(dry?'잠든 별샘':'되살아난 별샘',sx+5,y-78);
  if(!dry){ctx.fillStyle='#4fb3bb';ctx.fillRect(sx-40,y-14,96,11);ctx.fillStyle='#b4e4d9';ctx.fillRect(sx-19,y-13,40,2);}
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

 if(ssRegion==='mine'){

function drawWorld(){if(ssRegion==='life_forest_01'){drawM1ForestWorld();return;}let fromX=Math.max(0,Math.floor(camera.x/T)-1),toX=Math.min(WW,Math.ceil((camera.x+viewW)/T)+1),fromY=Math.max(0,Math.floor(camera.y/T)-1),toY=Math.min(WH,Math.ceil((camera.y+viewH)/T)+1);
 for(let y=fromY;y<=toY;y++)for(let x=fromX;x<=toX;x++){let t=tile(x,y);if(!t)continue;let sx=Math.round(x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.round(y*T-camera.y);ctx.drawImage(sprite(t,(x*3+y*7)&3),sx,sy,T+1,T+1);duriDrawOreWorldTile(t,x,y,sx,sy); if(t==='wall'){ctx.fillStyle='#160e081a';ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,T,T)} }
 // grass decoration, old trees and settlement graphics
 for(let x=fromX;x<=toX;x++){let s=terrain(x),sy=Math.round((s-1)*T-camera.y),sx=Math.round(x*T-camera.x);
 if(tile(x,s-1)==='grass'){
   if(rand(x,111)> .75){ctx.fillStyle='#4b8757';ctx.fillRect(sx+5,sy-5,2,7);ctx.fillRect(sx+8,sy-8,2,10);ctx.fillRect(sx+10,sy-4,2,6)}
   if(rand(x,222)>.954){ctx.fillStyle='#ffe2a1';ctx.fillRect(sx+8,sy-8,4,4);ctx.fillStyle='#7fc690';ctx.fillRect(sx+9,sy-4,2,5)}
 }
 if(biomeAt(x)==='desert' && tile(x,s-1)==='sand' && x%17===4){ctx.fillStyle='#45866a';ctx.fillRect(sx+10,sy-3*T,9,3*T);ctx.fillRect(sx+4,sy-2*T,7,7);ctx.fillRect(sx+3,sy-2*T,4,18);ctx.fillRect(sx+19,sy-2*T+8,9,6);ctx.fillRect(sx+24,sy-2*T,5,24)}
 if(biomeAt(x)==='snow'&&tile(x,s-1)==='snow'&&rand(x,33)>.8){ctx.fillStyle='#edf7ef';ctx.fillRect(sx+6,sy-4,7,4)}
 if(biomeAt(x)==='forest'&&x>80&&x%12>=3&&x%12<=5){let h=3+Math.floor(rand(x,8)*2),baseY=s-1,baseSY=Math.round(baseY*T-camera.y);let hasTrunk=tile(x,baseY-2)==='wood';if(hasTrunk){ctx.fillStyle='#805637';ctx.fillRect(sx+10,baseSY-(h+1)*T,8,(h+1)*T);ctx.fillStyle='#c08a50';ctx.fillRect(sx+12,baseSY-(h+1)*T,3,(h+1)*T);for(let k=0;k<4;k++){ctx.fillStyle=['#477a50','#578e58','#3c704c','#71a563'][k];ctx.fillRect(sx-22+k*5,baseSY-(h+3)*T+k*5,64-k*7,22)}ctx.fillStyle='#8abe76';ctx.fillRect(sx-5,baseSY-(h+3)*T+8,33,8)}}
 }
  for(const building of (ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID?BUILDING_DATA:[])){
    const img=BUILDING_IMAGES[building.id],sx=Math.round(building.x*T-48-camera.x),foot=(terrain(building.x)-1)*T-camera.y;
    const sy=Math.round(foot-80);
    if(sx>viewW+96||sx<-96||sy>viewH+80||sy<-80)continue;
    if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth===96){ctx.drawImage(img,sx,sy,96,80);}else{
      ctx.fillStyle='#775c49';ctx.fillRect(sx+7,sy+18,82,59);
    }
    const near=closestBuilding();if(near&&near.id===building.id){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#ffdea3';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(sx+28,sy+34,40,45);
    }
  }

 drawDuriFacilities();
 // Custom lift door sprites: anchored at the same gameplay stations.
 for(const station of (ssRegion==='mine'?STATION_DATA:[])){
  const x=station.x*T-camera.x,base=station.foot*T-camera.y;
  if(x < -LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH || x > viewW+LIFT_SPRITE_WIDTH || base < -LIFT_SPRITE_HEIGHT || base > viewH+LIFT_SPRITE_HEIGHT)continue;
  const unlocked=transportState().unlocked.includes(station.id);

 }
}
function drawPlayerLegacy(){let x=Math.round(p.x*T-camera.x),foot=Math.round(p.y*T-camera.y),s=Math.round(T/16),oy=foot-42+Math.round(Math.sin(frame*.14)*1.2*(Math.abs(p.vx)>0?1:0));

// SANDSTAR 2.15-C tool sprite atlas, 5 appearance tiers x 4 mining frames.
const forgeAppearanceImage=new Image();
let forgeAppearanceReady=false;
forgeAppearanceImage.onload=()=>{forgeAppearanceReady=forgeAppearanceImage.naturalWidth===128&&forgeAppearanceImage.naturalHeight===200};
forgeAppearanceImage.onerror=()=>{forgeAppearanceReady=false};
forgeAppearanceImage.src='data:image/png;base64,';
function forgeAppearanceTier(rank){
 const r=Number.isInteger(rank)?Math.max(0,Math.min(10,rank)):0;
 return r>=10?4:r>=7?3:r>=5?2:r>=3?1:0;
}
const FORGE_APPEARANCE_NAMES=['낡은 광부의 곡괭이','구리 장식 곡괭이','강철 곡괭이','결정 공명 곡괭이','흙별의 곡괭이'];
const FORGE_APPEARANCE_SHORT=['기본형','구리형','강철형','결정형','흙별형'];
function forgeAppearanceCard(rank,label){
 const tier=forgeAppearanceTier(rank),name=FORGE_APPEARANCE_NAMES[tier];
 return `<div class="forge-appearance-slot"><span class="forge-look" role="img" aria-label="${name} 도트 모습" data-tier="${tier}"></span><div><b>${label}</b><small class="forge-long">${name}</small><small class="forge-short">${FORGE_APPEARANCE_SHORT[tier]}</small></div></div>`;
}
function forgeAppearancePanel(rank,comparison){
 const next=Number.isInteger(comparison)?comparison:null;
 return `<div class="forge-appearance" aria-label="곡괭이 외형 단계 미리보기">${forgeAppearanceCard(rank,'현재 +'+rank)}${next===null?'':'<span class="forge-appearance-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>'+forgeAppearanceCard(next,'목표 +'+next)}</div><div class="forge-appearance-status">강화 단계에 따라 곡괭이 외형이 자동으로 바뀝니다. 외형은 강화 등급에 따라 바뀌며, 곡괭이 강화 효과는 장착 도구에만 적용돼요.</div>`;
}

minerToolImage.addEventListener('load',()=>{minerToolsReady=minerToolImage.naturalWidth===128&&minerToolImage.naturalHeight===120;});
